searchText: In terms of `ExecutionPayloadEnvelopeByRoot v1` where is `MAX_REQUEST_PAYLOAD` defined in the spec? Don't see it in the configs/presets Oh I didn't really pay attention to the beacon API at all. I'm not sure what the policy for PRs is there. In the CL spec we can merge features even if there's no consensus nor commitment to ship them. So it's easier to maintain. If we could do that on the APIs repo perhaps we could open the PR there. I have a personal apprehension to APIs but I'm sure someone will pick that up This is the p2p req/resp Oh this isn't defined in the P2P spec itself? Can you open a PR for it? I may have missed that. Yup. Making one right now. I suppose same number as MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB? Unless this has changed in Electra https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3890/ raised this Lgtm. Thanks for putting that together
